text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- South Korea's Daewoo could increase to $900 million from $500 million its investment in Morocco. The initial agreement was signed last July in Rabat.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali to start two-day official visit to Italy on Wednesday.
- Morocco and Iran trade joint commission to hold meetings in Rabat on Feb 26 and 28.

- Palestinan Authority President Yasser Arafat expected in Rabat to gain King Hassan's support against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's plans to establish new jewish settlements in East Jerusalem.
- World Bank to open in Morocco branch in charge of North Africa. The decision followed the visit of a bank's team last week.
